L11@P0-1: U.S. Securities and Exchange CommissionOFFICIAL LIST OF SECTION 13(f) SECURITIES USER INFORMATION SHEET
L12@P1: General
L13@P1: This list of “Section 13(f) securities” as defined by Rule 13f-1(c) [17 CFR
L14@P1: 240.13f-1(c)] is made available to the public pursuant to Section13 (f) (3) of the
L15@P1: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 [15 USC 78m(f) (3)]. It is made available for
L16@P1: use in the preparation of reports filed with the Securities and Exchange
L17@P1: Commission pursuant to Rule 13f-1 [17 CFR 240.13f-1] under Section 13(f) of
L18@P1: the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. An updated list is published on a quarterly
L19@P1: basis.
L20@P1: This list is current as of September 30, 2026, and may be relied on by
L21@P1: institutional investment managers filing Form 13F reports for the calendar
L22@P1: quarter ending September 30, 2026. Institutional investment managers should
L23@P1: report holdings--number of shares and fair market value--as of the last day of
L24@P1: the calendar quarter as required by [ Section 13(f)(1) and Rule 13f-1]
L25@P1: thereunder.
L26@P1: Features
L27@P1: (1) Additions and Deletions: Revisions made to the list of Section 13(f)
L28@P1: securities are indicated in a column titled “STATUS.” The word
L29@P1: “ADDED” in the status column opposite the name of a security
L30@P1: indicates that the security has become a Section 13(f) security.
L31@P1: The word “DELETED” in the status column opposite the name of a
L32@P1: security indicates that the security ceases to be a 13(f) security
L33@P1: since the date of the last list.
L34@P1: (2) List of options: An asterisk is placed next to the name of any
L35@P1: security having a listed option and each option is individually listed
L36@P1: with its own CUSIP number immediately below the name of the
L37@P1: security having the option. A manager reporting holdings of options
L38@P1: on its Form13F should use the CUSIP number of the underlying
L39@P1: securities to which the option relates.
